test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: "**Rubing**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Rubbing**".
 
• The mistake is in the use of "i" instead of "b".
 
• "**Rubbing**" means moving one's hand or a cloth back and forth over a surface. (किसी सतह पर अपना हाथ या कपड़ा आगे-पीछे हिलाना)
